reading: DSpark on RDNA4 is a shallow-context win only: ~4.3x decode at 60-token input (22->93-97 tok/s), ~2x with thinking on, but 0.24x at 49K input (21.2 -> 5.0-5.3 tok/s, accept len 2.6-2.8) and the 244K probe cannot be served at mem 0.85. The at-depth cost is the target-side TARGET_VERIFY forward over the deep KV (the RedHat draft's sliding-window attention did not help), i.e. the same unsplit extend-kernel verify that patch 065 addressed for tree verify; patch 065's gate requires spec_info.custom_mask, which DSpark's linear verify does not set, so it does not engage. The bake-off workload decodes at a 34-37K median context, so DSpark as-is would be net negative for the evals.
